
```{python}
# %%
# Read in libraries
import polars as pl
import polars.selectors as cs
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *
LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn import metrics
df = pl.read_csv("https://github.com/byuidatascience/data4dwellings/raw/master/data-raw/dwellings_ml/dwellings_ml.csv")
```


```{python}
# Clean data
x = df.select(cs.exclude("parcel", "abstrprd", "yrbuilt", "before1980"))
y = df.select("before1980")

x_train, x_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(x, y, test_size=0.34, random_state=76)
```

Q1 - What is the average of the first 10 values in your testing y values?
```{python}
print(y_test[:10])

sum = 0
for i in range(10):
    sum += y_test[i]

print(sum / 10)
```

Q2 - What is the average of the first 10 values in your training X values for the selling price sprice?
```{python}
print(x_train["sprice"][:10])

sum = 0
for i in range(10):
    sum += x_train["sprice"][i]

print(f"{sum / 10:,.0f}")

```
